title: Signum-Gordon spectral mass from nonlinear Fourier mode mixing
summary: We investigate the emergence of a spectral mass in the signum-Gordon model, a nonlinear field theory characterized by a non-analytic, V-shaped potential where standard perturbative mass definitions are inapplicable. By analyzing the evolution of monochromatic wave trains, we identify two distinct dynamical regimes governed by the relationship between the wave's amplitude and its wavenumber.
